in_hebrew.name: Fotinas
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fotinas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'otheinos', meaning 'of God'. This name was given to honor the divine intervention in one's life.

in_latin.name: Fotinas

in_latin.long_meaning: Fotinas est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'otheinos', meaning 'of God'. This name was given to honor the divine intervention in one's life.
